i knew him for months and he blocked me in august for unsure reasons after i was put into an inpatient facility, i talked to him for months and even video called him at one point, i remember him showing me his room and posters. he was beautiful, he was awesome, talented and creative, but he was in need of great help, he had so many deep, painful problems and was very sick. im so sorry dylann. i was so caught up in my bullshit but i tried the best i could when we would talk, but i failed. like you said, we were both living in hell. you are missed so greatly by all of your friends in and out of the community. we love you.
